page_title: BRE 0-1 NIC | Brest v Nice 02/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+1' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Evann Guessand and he is replaced by Youssoufa Moukoko (Nice).
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
88' Substitution. Massadio Haidara (Brest) replaces Jordan Amavi.
87' A pass from Kenny Lala (Brest) is intercepted by Marcin Bulka and the move breaks down.
84' Mohamed Abdelmonem (Nice) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Clement Turpin had an easy-decision to make.
81' Kenny Lala (Brest) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
79' We are about to witness a substitution. Romain Faivre (Brest) is replacing Romain Del Castillo.
79' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Mahdi Camara is replaced by Jonas Martin (Brest).
76' The substitution is prepared. Sofiane Diop (Nice) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mohamed-Ali Cho.
76' Substitution. Jonathan Clauss walks off the pitch and Antoine Mendy (Nice) comes on as a substitute.
76' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) replaces Youssouf Ndayishimiye.
74' Dante (Nice) has tested the patience of referee Clement Turpin and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
69' Substitution. Ibrahim Salah (Brest) in, Mama Balde out.
69' The referee signals a substitution. Kamory Doumbia (Brest) is brought on as a substitute for Hugo Magnetti.
65' Wonderful movement by Nice. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
62' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Jeremie Boga will be replaced by Gaetan Laborde (Nice).
60' Mama Balde (Brest) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Marcin Bulka comes off his line to intercept.

58' Mama Balde (Brest) makes some space to meet a perfect cross inside the box, but he blazes his shot over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
55' Brest failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

55' Marcin Bulka makes a brilliant save! Jordan Amavi (Brest) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper! Brest have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
53' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) is penalised for a foul. Clement Turpin had a clear view and blows his whistle.
51' The corner is swung in but Brest can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
50' POST! Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!
48' Brest take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

48' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper. Brest force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
47' There's an opportunity for Romain Del Castillo (Brest) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Clement Turpin has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Jeremie Boga (Nice) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
44' Mahdi Camara (Brest) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
42' 0 - 1 Goal! Ali Abdi shows great vision to find Evann Guessand (Nice) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the roof of the net. 0:1.

40' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Nice are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
38' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Nice players look gutted.
38' Wait! Referee Clement Turpin has indicated he is going to review the Nice goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
37' Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Ali Abdi finds Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
35' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
35' Jordan Amavi (Brest) makes a rough challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul. Nice are awarded the free kick.
34' Clement Turpin blows his whistle and it's Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
31' Marcin Bulka makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) after a cross from the side.
29' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
27' Mama Balde (Brest) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
26' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Kenny Lala (Brest), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
25' Nice are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
23' Ali Abdi (Nice) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Bizot comes off his line to gather the ball.

20' CLOSE! Ali Abdi (Nice) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
19' Jeremie Boga (Nice) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Marco Bizot allowed him to make a comfortable save.
18' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
17' Evann Guessand (Nice) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
15' Brest seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
13' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
12' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
10' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Kenny Lala (Brest).
8' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
7' Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Clement Turpin no option but to blow his whistle.
5' Jeremie Boga (Nice) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
3' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

2' Mahdi Camara (Brest) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets too much on the ball and it goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brest comes to nothing.
2' Mahdi Camara (Brest) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brest will have the kick-off.
Clement Turpin will officiate today.
